svg.title: SAE Framework V3.3 — native card-based organization architecture
svg.desc: Scientist leads scientific decisions; GPT is Architect and Mentor; Codex engineers and executes authorized experiments; GitHub is the evidence hub, Colab CLI is the execution layer.
